title: Single emergency number
note: Fire, police, ambulance and gas services across Ukraine.

title: Fire and rescue (State Emergency Service)
note: Fire, rescue, downed power lines, an explosive object found. 24/7.

title: Police
note: A crime or incident that needs police at once. 24/7.

title: Ambulance
note: A threat to life or health. 24/7.

title: Gas emergency
note: A smell or leak of gas. If the smell persists: 104 or 112.

title: Crisis hotline
note: Evacuation, housing and payments for displaced people, humanitarian aid, seized homes. 24/7, free.

title: East SOS: evacuation
note: Evacuation requests, including people with limited mobility; help for displaced people. Mon–Sat 08:00–18:00, free.

title: Ukrainian Railways
note: Trains, including evacuation trains. 24/7.

title: Ukrainian Red Cross
note: Information on aid, support, tracing missing relatives. Daily 09:00–18:00, free.

title: International Committee of the Red Cross
note: Help for people affected by the war, tracing relatives. Mon–Fri 09:00–13:00 and 14:00–17:00, free.

title: National Psychological Association
note: A free, confidential talk with a psychologist. Daily; hours differ between sources.

title: People in Need support line
note: Psychological support for adults and children. 24/7.

title: Support line for men
note: Stress, crisis, burnout. 14:00–06:00; free from mobiles.

title: Varto zhyty crisis counselling
note: Mon–Fri 11:00–19:00; free from lifecell, Vodafone and Kyivstar.

title: Violence and trafficking
note: Domestic and gender-based violence, violence against children, trafficking; a psychologist is available. 24/7, free.

title: Line 1547 from abroad
note: The same as 1547; meant for calls from abroad, works from Ukraine too. Normal call rates.

title: La Strada: against violence
note: Domestic violence, trafficking, discrimination. 24/7, free from mobiles and landlines.

title: La Strada: short number
note: The same as 0 800 500 335, from mobiles. 24/7, free.

title: Children's hotline
note: Anonymous, for children and young people; advice for adults on children's rights. Free from mobiles.

title: Children's hotline (0 800)
note: The same as 116 111, from mobiles and landlines.

title: National Health Service
note: Free services, Affordable Medicines, facilities contracted by the NHSU. Mon–Thu 09:00–18:00, Fri to 16:45.

title: Ministry of Health hotline
note: Questions and complaints about health care. Daily 08:00–20:00.

title: HIV/AIDS helpline
note: Counsellors, psychologists, infectious-disease doctors.

title: Opioid substitution therapy
note: Questions about substitution therapy. 09:00–18:00, free, anonymous.

title: Security Service (SBU)
note: Sabotage, paid arson, suspicious people or objects, recruitment. Free from all operators.

title: SBU (previous number)
note: Still working. Free.

title: Ministry of Defence
note: Matters within the Ministry of Defence's remit. 24/7; calls are recorded.

title: National Information Bureau
note: Report people captured, deported or missing, including children. 24/7.

title: NIB from abroad
note: The same as 1648; meant for calls from abroad, works from Ukraine too. 24/7; normal call rates.

title: Missing persons
note: Commissioner for persons missing under special circumstances; the single register. Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00.

title: POW Coordination HQ
note: Advice for families of captured or missing service members.

title: Centre for search and release of POWs
note: Prisoners of war, illegally detained civilians, deported children. Kyiv landline, normal call rates.

title: Unified veterans line
note: Status and ID, benefits, psychological support, housing, work. Daily 08:00–20:00; advice is free.

title: Veterans Fund crisis line
note: Psychological crisis support for veterans and families. 24/7, free.

title: Veteran Hub
note: Veterans, service members, families of captives and the missing. Daily 09:00–21:00; normal call rates.

title: Government hotline
note: Appeals to any government body. Free from the main operators.

title: Government hotline from abroad
note: The same as 1545; meant for calls from abroad, works from Ukraine too. Normal call rates.

title: Free legal aid
note: A lawyer's advice Mon–Fri 08:00–18:00; reporting a detention 24/7. Free.

title: Legal aid from abroad
note: The same as 0 800 213 103; meant for calls from abroad, works from Ukraine too. Normal call rates.

title: Ombudsman
note: Rights violated, including captured or deported civilians. Mon–Thu 09:00–18:00, Fri to 16:45; free.

title: Ombudsman: second number
note: The same as 1678; same hours.

title: Ombudsman from abroad
note: The same as 1678; meant for calls from abroad, works from Ukraine too. Normal call rates.

title: Pension Fund
note: Pensions and social payments. Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00, Sat 08:00–14:00.

title: National Social Service
note: Social benefits and services. Mon–Thu 10:30–15:00, Fri to 14:45.

title: Diia support
note: The Diia app and portal. Mobile number, normal call rates.

title: Police: non-emergency
note: Police matters that don't need an immediate response. Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00. Emergencies: 102.

title: Cyber police
note: Fraud, cybercrime, status of a report. Mon–Thu 09:00–18:00, Fri to 17:00.

title: Ministry of Internal Affairs
note: Appeals and enquiries to the Interior Ministry.

title: Border Guard Service
note: Questions about crossing the border.

title: Border Guard from abroad
note: The same as 1598; meant for calls from abroad, works from Ukraine too. Normal call rates.

title: Foreign Ministry contact centre
note: Enquiries to the Foreign Ministry. 24/7; Kyiv landline.

title: Foreign Ministry crisis line
note: Ukrainian citizens in trouble abroad. Kyiv landline, normal call rates.
